name: Ingest messages
description: Ingest messages Processes a conversation and extracts structured memories from it. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/agent-memory/namespaces/{namespace_name}/profiles/{profile_name}/ingest
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/agent-memory/namespaces/{namespace_name}/profiles/{profile_name}/ingest
Processes a conversation and extracts structured memories from it. Agent Memory identifies facts, events, instructions, and tasks automatically.
Required: account_id (path) — Cloudflare Account ID.; namespace_name (path); profile_name (path); body (body)

name: Delete a memory
description: Delete a memory Deletes a memory by ID. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/agent-memory/namespaces/{namespace_name}/profiles/{profile_name}/memories/{memory_id}

name: Get a memory
description: Get a memory Retrieves a memory by ID. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/agent-memory/namespaces/{namespace_name}/profiles/{profile_name}/memories/{memory_id}

name: List memories
description: List memories List memories stored in a profile. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/agent-memory/namespaces/{namespace_name}/profiles/{profile_name}/memories
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/agent-memory/namespaces/{namespace_name}/profiles/{profile_name}/memories
List memories stored in a profile.
Required: account_id (path) — Cloudflare Account ID.; namespace_name (path); profile_name (path)
Optional: per_page (query); cursor (query); session_id (query); type (query)

name: Create a namespace
description: Create a namespace Creates a new memory namespace owned by the account. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/agent-memory/namespaces
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/agent-memory/namespaces
Creates a new memory namespace owned by the account.
Required: account_id (path) — Cloudflare Account ID.; body (body)

name: Delete a namespace
description: Delete a namespace Deletes a namespace. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/agent-memory/namespaces/{namespace_name}

name: Get a namespace
description: Get a namespace Gets a namespace by name. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/agent-memory/namespaces/{namespace_name}

name: List namespaces
description: List namespaces Lists all namespaces for the given account. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/agent-memory/namespaces
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/agent-memory/namespaces
Lists all namespaces for the given account. Results are paginated.
Required: account_id (path) — Cloudflare Account ID.
Optional: per_page (query); order (query); direction (query); cursor (query)

name: Delete a profile
description: Delete a profile Marks a profile for deletion. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/agent-memory/namespaces/{namespace_name}/profiles/{profile_name}

name: List profiles
description: List profiles Lists the profiles of a namespace, ordered by name. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/agent-memory/namespaces/{namespace_name}/profiles
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/agent-memory/namespaces/{namespace_name}/profiles
Lists the profiles of a namespace, ordered by name. A profile appears once it has been used.
Required: account_id (path) — Cloudflare Account ID.; namespace_name (path)
Optional: per_page (query); cursor (query)
